info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Investment Management Investment Accounts-spec
info.description: The Investment Accounts Lookup API enables users to access a comprehensive list of investment accounts within the investment management system. This endpoint provides valuable information on different investment accounts, facilitating management and analysis of financial portfolios. It is primarily intended for financial advisors, portfolio managers, and clients looking to monitor their investments. By integrating this API, developers can enhance applications that require real-time investment account data and improve user financial decision-making capabilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about an investment account, including account balances, transaction history, and investment performance metrics.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching investment account details. This request requires the client to provide necessary details in the JSON format to retrieve the corresponding investment account information.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the investment account data.
